tagline: 禄来胶片相机，1949 年发布
description: 禄来于1949年推出的胶片相机。配备Carl Zeiss Jena Tessar 1:2.8 f=80mm, coated. or : Zeiss Oberkochen Opton Tessar 1:2.8 f=80mm, coated.。快门速度Compur-Rapid X CR0 leafshutter. Speeds 1 to 1/400 sec.(later to 1/500 sec.) and B.。使用12 exposures of 6 x 6 cm on 120 type rollfilm. Furthermore a Plate adapter for sheet film and a Rolleikin adapter for 35mm film cartridges can be used.。

specs.胶片/画幅: 12 exposures of 6 x 6 cm on 120 type rollfilm. Furthermore a Plate adapter for sheet film and a Rolleikin adapter for 35mm film cartridges can be used.
specs.镜头: Carl Zeiss Jena Tessar 1:2.8 f=80mm, coated. or : Zeiss Oberkochen Opton Tessar 1:2.8 f=80mm, coated.
specs.快门: Compur-Rapid X CR0 leafshutter. Speeds 1 to 1/400 sec.(later to 1/500 sec.) and B.
specs.闪光灯: Sync socket on frontpanel. X synchronization, later also M-synchronization.
specs.英文简介: Germany 1949, four years after the end of WWII and the country is still in ruins.
